ios.desc:
Instasearch lets you do fast and easy searches by letting you query once and search everywhere. It lets you swipe between search results from related sites and applications. It saves your search history and groups them by day. You can star your searches to return back to them later. You can avoid jumping between different apps to do searches by using Instasearch.

 === Main Features ===

• Pick a category to search in by tapping the category icon, including General, Location, Social, Movies, Knowledge and Shopping

• Pick the search engine you want to query first in a category

• Swipe between results from different sites 

• Or tap the search engine icon in the toolbar to pick another search engine or category to search with

• Save searches to return to them later

• View your search history grouped by day

 === Supported Search Engines ===

• General: Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Yahoo

• Location: Yelp, Google Places

• Social: Twitter, YouTube, Google+, Flickr, Pinterest

• Movies: Rotten Tomatoes, IMDb, Wikipedia

• Knowledge: Wikipedia, GoodReads, WolframAlpha

• Shopping: Amazon, Ebay
